q: Which month does B think is best?

context.title: 去哪儿旅游
lines: A：我想去北京旅游，你觉得几月去最好？  (I want to visit Beijing. Which month is best?)
B：十月最好，不冷也不热。  (October is best: not cold, not hot.)
A：你和我一起去吗？  (Will you come with me?)
B：好啊！我也想去。  (Sure! I want to go too.)

why: B says 十月最好, so October is the best month.

not.September: B says 十月, not 九月.
not.July: B says 十月, not 七月.
not.December: There is no 十二月 in the text; B says 十月.
